comment: The showcase film: every shot is the real app recorded in the XR emulator (artifacts/video/scenes/<src>, 1440 px). Fields as in film.json.

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.narration: AstraCAD Spatial is a complete CAD workstation inside Meta Quest. Sketch, model, assemble, test and make real parts, with your hands and your voice, and every part is checked before it leaves the bench.
bullets: Sketch, model, assemble, test and manufacture
Hands and voice, in your own room
Every part checked by exact maths

chapters.title: The bench, in your room
chapters.narration: It runs in the Quest browser, with nothing to install. The bench lands on your desk, anchors to the room, and a guide lights up each next step.
bullets: WebXR in the Quest Browser: no install
A guide for each next step

chapters.title: Shape it with your hands
chapters.narration: Pinch a handle and pull. The kernel rebuilds the solid as you move, and the truth gate checks it against an exact formula, to better than one part in a billion.
bullets: Pinch and pull: the solid rebuilds live
Truth gate: closed-form volume, size and holes
A part that fails is never shown as verified

chapters.title: Or just say it
chapters.narration: Or just say it. Speech is recognised on the headset, and every size comes from your words. Type it if you prefer: the same commands work either way.
bullets: Sizes come only from your words
Voice and typing share one command set

chapters.title: A real sketcher
chapters.narration: Point at any face and open a sketch. Lines chain and snap to points, centres and midpoints. A tangent arc, a circle, then Smart Dimension: say forty five, and the solver makes it so. Extrude, and the profile becomes a verified solid.
bullets: Line, rectangle, circle, arc, slot, polygon
Snaps and relations, solved by FreeCAD's planeGCS
Smart Dimension by voice; degrees of freedom shown
Extrude, cut or revolve every closed region

chapters.title: Every sketch tool
chapters.narration: The sketch tools you expect: fillet a corner, offset an outline, mirror, trim and extend, draw splines and ellipses, and sketch on planes at any angle.

chapters.title: Every feature, one ribbon
chapters.narration: Every feature lives in a ribbon of tabs: create, holes, modify, sheet metal and output. Add a boss, drill a hole where you point, pattern it round, and fillet the result.
bullets: A ribbon of tabs, pressed by hand
Create, holes, modify, sheet metal, output
Holes where you point, patterns, fillets

chapters.title: Production features
chapters.narration: Production features come from a sentence: an involute spur gear, a metric thread, a loft from a rectangle to a circle, and a pipe swept along a bent path.
bullets: ISO involute gears and metric threads
Sweeps along paths with round bends

chapters.title: Fillet and chamfer any edge
chapters.narration: Point at any edge, straight or curved. A rolling ball follows tangent edges, chamfers follow any curve, and round all edges does the whole part at once.
bullets: Rolling-ball fillets that follow tangent edges
Round every edge in one step

chapters.title: Freeform and organic
chapters.narration: For shapes that are not boxes, pull the control points of a B-spline surface by hand. Or push and pull a subdivision cage, mirrored left to right, into a smooth organic solid.
bullets: B-spline surfaces shaped by their control points

chapters.title: Springs, knurls and finish
chapters.narration: Mechanical details are real geometry: a closed-end compression spring, a diamond knurl with real teeth, and lettering engraved into the face. Then choose how it looks: anodised, brushed aluminium, or carbon fibre.
bullets: Springs and coils on a helix

chapters.title: Blades and propellers
chapters.narration: Fans and propellers are built from NACA airfoil sections, tapered and twisted along the span, and joined to their hub.
bullets: Taper and twist from root to tip
Any number of blades round a hub

chapters.title: Sheet metal
chapters.narration: Sheet metal works like it does at the bench: a base flange, edge flanges at any angle, a hem, a flange on a flange. Then save the flat pattern as DXF, with every bend allowance worked out.
bullets: Flanges, hems, jogs and mitre flanges
Exact bends, verified in closed form
Flat pattern DXF with bend allowance

chapters.title: Weldments
chapters.narration: Sketch a frame as lines, and turn it into structural members: square tube here. The cut list gives every length and its mass.
bullets: A cut list with lengths and mass

chapters.title: Moulds and castings
chapters.narration: Ready to mould it? Draft analysis colours every face: green and blue release, amber needs draft. Then find the parting line, and split a mould block into core and cavity.
bullets: The parting line, found and drawn

chapters.title: Equations and configurations
chapters.narration: Design intent stays editable. A variable drives the flange through an equation. Save configurations, and switch the whole part between them.
bullets: A design table for every size

chapters.title: Test it with your hand
chapters.narration: Now test it. Push with your open palm, and the stress solver runs live, cross-checked against CalculiX. Three engineering agents read every result and suggest the fix.
bullets: A live load from your open palm
Agents for strength, printing and cost

chapters.title: Lighter, and steady
chapters.narration: Grow bone strips away the material the load does not need, and vibration finds each natural frequency and its mode shape.

chapters.title: Assemblies in motion
chapters.narration: Assemble parts with mates: coincident, concentric, hinges, sliders, gears, screws and rack and pinion. Turn the hinge, and a four-bar linkage runs through its full revolution.
bullets: Mates, including gears, screws, racks and limits
Hinges you turn by hand, with limits
Closed loops solved, like a four-bar linkage

chapters.title: Drawings and STEP
chapters.narration: Every part has its drawing: three views, hidden edges dashed, and geometric tolerances to ISO. And it exports as STEP, with true cylinders, straight into SOLIDWORKS, CATIA or Creo.
bullets: GD&T: datums and feature control frames

chapters.title: Take it with you
chapters.narration: When it is right, take it with you: STL or 3MF for your slicer, G-code sliced on the headset, a share code for your phone, or a co-design room another headset can join.

chapters.title: Made for everyone
chapters.narration: Captions, dwell to select, large text and one-handed use are built in, and on Meta's glasses the layout fits the narrower view.

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.narration: Two hundred and forty engine tests. No install, no account, no server. AstraCAD Spatial: design anything, right where you are.
bullets: Works offline: no account, no server
chapters.kicker: Design anything, right where you are.
